en.title: Consentinel
en.short: Behavior-aware permission kernel for autonomous AI agents. It decides pass, step-up, or deny from a user behavior graph and vector memory.
en.description: An agent-first middleware for dynamic permissions. Static scopes do not work well for autonomous agents: either the user grants a permanent master key, or the agent gets blocked every few minutes. The kernel sits between the agent and the action and decides whether a requested operation looks reasonable for this user, this context, and this track record. Agents call MCP tools. The kernel decides whether a requested action should pass autonomously, pass with audit, require biometric step-up, or be denied.
features: MCP tools to record track events, assess an agent action, explain permission memory, and create a step-up challenge
Decisions: allow, allow with audit, biometric step-up, or deny
Behavior graph of users, agents, services, actions, resources, counterparties, and prior outcomes
Vector memory of past action narratives for fuzzy precedent matching
Risk policy engine for novelty, amount deviation, sensitivity, reversibility, and permission viability
Optional payment context such as x402 when the agent is moving value

es.title: Consentinel
es.short: Kernel de permisos para agentes autónomos. Decide pass, step-up o deny según un grafo de comportamiento del usuario y memoria vectorial.
es.description: Middleware agent-first para permisos dinámicos. Los scopes estáticos no funcionan bien con agentes autónomos: o se da una master key permanente, o el agente se bloquea cada pocos minutos. El kernel se pone entre el agente y la acción y decide si la operación pedida parece razonable para este usuario, este contexto y este historial. Los agentes llaman tools MCP. El kernel decide si la acción pasa de forma autónoma, pasa con auditoría, pide step-up biométrico o se deniega.
features: Tools MCP para registrar eventos, evaluar una acción del agente, explicar la memoria de permisos y crear un challenge de step-up
Decisiones: allow, allow with audit, step-up biométrico o deny
Grafo de comportamiento de usuarios, agentes, servicios, acciones, recursos, contrapartes y resultados previos
Memoria vectorial de narrativas de acciones para buscar precedentes
Motor de riesgo: novelty, desvío de monto, sensibilidad, reversibilidad y viabilidad del permiso
Contexto de pago opcional (x402) cuando el agente mueve valor

en.title: Clippy
en.short: Local-first pipeline that takes raw training/stream videos, finds the interesting moments, cuts clips, reframes them, and auto-subtitles them.
en.description: Local-first Python pipeline that takes raw streams and training recordings, detects the most interesting moments, cuts the clips, reframes them to vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9), and auto-subtitles them with karaoke style. Built for Google Meet-style recordings with a shared slide plus webcam, educational content in Spanish, with human review before the final render. Pipeline: ingest -> transcribe -> signals -> propose -> human review -> render.

Web UI to drag an mp4, review clips, edit in/out and subtitles word by word, then render
CLI to process, review, approve, set ranges, edit words, and render
Moment scoring with OpenCode Go, Ollama, Anthropic, or a heuristic baseline
Karaoke captions by default; social style for Shorts/Reels
Requires Python 3.11+ and ffmpeg

en.title: Prognosia Health
en.short: 100% local clinical assistant on QVAC (Aleph Hackathon 2026). Captures a consult, extracts a SOAP note, applies a deterministic guardrail, and proposes an EHR write that stays pending_human.
en.description: 100% local clinical assistant on QVAC (Aleph Hackathon 2026, QVAC track). It captures a medical consult (voice or text), extracts a SOAP note with a local LLM, applies a deterministic guardrail (severe asthma + non-selective beta blocker -> blocked), and builds an EHR proposal (SOAP delta + write actions + gaps) always pending_human. No cloud inference. Models: WHISPER_BASE_Q8_0 + VAD_SILERO and QWEN3_4B_INST_Q4_K_M. Rules in prognosia/rules.py. EHR agent in prognosia/propose.py (no LLM).
features: 100% local inference: Whisper STT + Qwen3-4B via tetherto-qvac-sdk
Deterministic guardrail with a trace from record to consult
EHR proposal always pending_human; writes never auto-commit
Web shell on 127.0.0.1; records and runs do not leave localhost
Stack exposed at GET /api/config with cloud_inference: false

en.title: Lunar & Martian Seismic Detection
en.short: On-board LSTM model trained on NASA Apollo & InSight data to filter seismic signals from noise in deep space. 2nd place NASA Space Apps 2024.
en.description: Seismic detection system trained on real data from NASA's Apollo (Moon) and InSight (Mars) missions using LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) neural networks. Transmitting data from distant bodies requires energy that scales with distance, and seismic events are rare, so most transmitted data is noise. Our solution runs classification algorithms on-board to separate seismic signals from noise in situ, sending only useful data back to Earth. The required software and hardware are low-cost in terms of development, operation, energy, and footprint, maximizing the scientific value of every transmitted byte.
features: Machine learning model for seismic pattern recognition
Data preprocessing pipeline for space seismic data
Real-time seismic event detection
Visualization dashboard for seismic activity
Scientific data analysis and reporting

es.description: Sistema de detección sísmica entrenado con datos reales de las misiones Apollo (Luna) e InSight (Marte) de la NASA usando redes neuronales LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory). Transmitir datos desde cuerpos distantes requiere un consumo energético que escala con la distancia, y los eventos sísmicos son raros, por lo que la mayor parte de los datos transmitidos es ruido. Nuestra solución ejecuta algoritmos de clasificación a bordo para separar las señales sísmicas del ruido in situ, enviando solo datos útiles a la Tierra. El software y hardware necesarios son de bajo costo en desarrollo, operación, energía y espacio, maximizando el valor científico de cada byte transmitido.
features: Modelo de aprendizaje automático para reconocimiento de patrones sísmicos
